text.text_excerpt: My co-workers would say since this location open I became worse than a crack addict. I will admit I went on a little craze time where I couldn't get enough and I can say I have calmed down. But now to the review.... Staff... Talk about friendly... Every time I come here early morning at 7am or Lunch time at 12pm, the staff is always so sweet and friendly. They answer the questions but not with an attitude. They help me pick the best tasting smoothies and everything. I really just love this sweet staff. I never had a problem and I have been in there MANY times since opening. Smoothies.... MMMM, I love the smoothies... Specifically any smoothie they put energy boost in. I'm good for the com...

I love the text specials they do here! I get text messages offering $1 smoothies, oatmeal, etc at least once a week. Jamba Juice used to be a puzzling concept to me, because while they claimed to be all healthy and whatnot, the majority of their smoothies were loaded with sorbet, frozen yogurt, etc which made the smoothies high in sugar, fat, carbs, and calories. Well, they still offer those smoothies, but they also have a great selection of fresh squeezed juices now; try the Great Greens with apples, cucumbers, Supergreens, lemons, and chia seeds! They also have wheatgrass shots, which is awesome since Surrey's no longer does wheatgrass shots (WTF?). If you are more in the smoothie mood,...

Yes! I have been wanting to try this spot for the longest time and I finally made it in! I have been making an effort to drink something green every day- my fridge is filled with green juice. I got the Amazing Greens smoothie, which is packed with greens, bananas, peaches and a whole lot of other goodies. It came out a really rich and bright green color and it tasted delightful. It had a bit of a tart flavor, but I could definitely taste the sweet of the fruits more than the veggies. I got a medium, but when I return, I will definitely get a small because it takes a while to sip and it warmed up because I was taking my time with it.
